newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland picks adviser in power, heating plant sale.
newsitem.headline: Poland picks adviser in power, heating plant sale.

text.p: The Polish Industry Ministry appointed Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA (BGZ) as its adviser in the planned privatisation of Elektrocieplownia Bedzin SA power and heating plant, BGZ said in a statement on Tuesday.
BGZ said said it would advise the ministry along with an auditing firm, a law firm and a consultancy.
It said the planned sale, which under a tentative plan would involve Bedzin's public offering, would be the first-ever privatisation of a Polish power-generating company.
BGZ gave no further details and ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
